papers.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
papers.summary: A reciprocal world model enables real-time full-duplex audiovisual interaction by jointly modeling intent and realization using autoregressive reasoning, synchronized attention, and dual rollout distillation.

papers.title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
papers.summary: A systematic study of Hyper-Connections architectures identifies the simpler efficient design SimpleHC, which removes residual mixing and uses shared memory access to match mHC performance while adding minimal training overhead and improving stability.
